items.html: And behold, on the first day of Rosh HaShanah, all the Gevurot that are in his Keter until the completion of all his Tifferet are sawed off and given to her, in her Keter; and she stands at the back of the lower half of his Tifferet. In that he is sawed of his KHB and HGT, and she was not sawed from him except her Keter alone, and all those Gevurot gathered in her Keter.
